hypothesis: Retiring near-side old support while preserving same-plane and far-side support can improve measured surface depth without damaging parent RGB or other surfaces.
groups: The same three BUILD-measured groups; no new geometry, color or scale fitting

layers.definition: Persistent object-reference normal slabs relative to each measured plane; not image-space gating
layers.range: Fixed measured car box plus 0.28m, projected onto the normal; original tangent bounds unchanged
layers.eligibility: Same BUILD-registered native a6 rows; no other components may retire
layers.camera_check: BUILD camera origins must have consistent plane side; otherwise abstain
layers.limit: Normal slabs are a physical support decomposition, not per-ray depth reordering or an opaque first hit

proxy_fit.scope: One shared opacity multiplier per group/layer, BUILD only
proxy_fit.rule: 10 bisection iterations on pooled old-plus-new alphaT budget

acceptance.no_op: Explicit asset fallback; exact output parity required
acceptance.build: Group RGB no worse than parent (1e-7 numeric allowance), group depth strictly better than parent by >1e-5m, no worse than retirement, coverage abs error <=0.01, all inherited black guards pass
acceptance.held: Frozen coefficients; same parent RGB/depth requirement, both RGB/depth better than same retirement, coverage abs error <=0.01
acceptance.scene: All49 black/keep/delete inherited guards and road/seam pooled guards
acceptance.non_target_depth: Same fixed measured depth pixels outside group; mean absolute rendered depth change <=0.005m per frame in each state
acceptance.intervention: Report removed group alphaT; a zero-mass layer is inapplicable rather than evidence against hypothesis
acceptance.selection: If BUILD or HELD fails, final selected asset is zero operation; all diagnostic arms remain reported

held_limit: Repeated mechanism diagnostics; not an untouched test set or independent generalization
smoke: real renderer no-op in all states
near+same+far conditional mass equals full physical column
